entities.name: great old willow with a split trunk at the top of the bank
entities.what: Huge old pollarded willow whose gnarled, knobbed trunk is split into two legs like an inverted V: a western leg (foot about (22225, 290)) and a thicker eastern leg (foot about (22345, 318)) that twist up into one knobbed head at about (22180-22330, 50-150); from the head long thin whips spray in every direction, west over the trackers to about u 21870 and east over the bamboo fence and the house roof to about u 22520, cut off by the silk's top edge. Whips drawn as fine lines without leaf masses (early spring).
entities.vis: part: crown cut by the silk's top edge; the legs' feet blurred by ground wash
entities.note: The tree is certain; how many trees is not. My reading: ONE tree with a split (hollow) trunk: the two legs join at the top in one continuous knobbed head (dark mass u 22180-22330, v 50-150) and are linked near the ground by a darker root band at v 273-301 between them. OTHER READING: two willows standing about 130 px apart whose heads merge; then split this into two trees with bases at foot_w and foot_e. base = midway between the two legs' feet (est); foot_w and foot_e are custom points for the builder. Strokes: western leg u 22190-22245 from v 150 down to v 285-295; eastern leg u 22295-22380 from v 180 down to v 310-325; knob head u 22180-22330, v 50-150; whips reach the silk's top edge (v about 18-22) from u 22100 to 22420. Trunk girth at the foot about 50 px (west leg) and 40-75 px (east leg). The restyle draws two trunks with a limb bridging them, and two invented walkers below (22200 and 22380, v 290-420). Crops: scratchpad S2_t3/z2_willow.jpg, e_willow_base.jpg, e_ctx.jpg, inspect_22300_200.jpg.

entities.name: dense dark shrub (or lattice screen) at the house's west corner
entities.what: A dark, densely hatched mass about 40 px wide and 95 px tall standing at the west end of the house, just east of the willow's eastern leg and below the east end of the bamboo fence: read as a dense low shrub against the wall; it may instead be a woven or lattice screen at the house's corner.
entities.note: Strokes: u 22395-22437, v 195-290; the upper part (v 195-235) has crossing diagonal strokes like a coarse lattice, the lower part (v 235-290) dark blotchy leafy marks; a lighter strip separates it from the willow's eastern leg (u 22380-22395). OTHER READING: a lattice or wattle screen fixed to the house (the restyle draws a diamond lattice under the house's window): then it is part of structures_w's building and this entity is dropped. Recorded here because a miss is worse than a duplicate. Crops: scratchpad S2_t3/e_hatch.jpg, e_willow_base.jpg.

entities.name: clump of tall weeds at the wall corner
entities.what: A clump of tall grass or weed stems arching east, with a low leafy mass at its foot, growing at the foot of the house wall just east of the gate, against the house's west corner post; the west end of the strip of shrubs along the wall.
entities.note: Strokes: leafy dark mass u 22625-22657, v 325-405 beside the corner post (u 22650-22654, v 290-340, structures_w's); arching stems u 22662-22705, v 350-372. Painted height about 70 px. Continues east as S2.tree.shrub_row_22805. The restyle also draws weeds here. Crops: scratchpad S2_t3/e_clump.jpg, e_shrubs.jpg, inspect_22700_300.jpg.

entities.name: row of low shrubs along the house wall's foot
entities.what: A continuous low row of small leafy shrubs and weeds along the foot of the plain south wall of the long house, from the weed clump at the west corner east to the house's east corner post, about knee high against the wall.
entities.note: One entity for a continuous strip: individual bushes can't be separated on the strokes (mottled small leaf marks u 22705-22905, v 350-414; its foot line runs about (22705, 406) -> (22905, 414)); a builder places a row of small shrubs along it. Painted height about 45-60 px against the wall (the wall's foot at v about 405-415, its eave at v 290). The restyle draws sparse grass here and invents a stair and walkers on the bank below it. Crops: scratchpad S2_t3/e_shrubs.jpg, e_shrubs_z35.jpg, e_bank_e.jpg.
